title: Lowo Ukhutshelwe Ngaphandle Kuvavanyo Lwamanzi
intro: Kwimbali yezibhalo zakudala, kukho umntu onomdla obali lakhe aliqali ngommangaliso omkhulu okanye ngesityhilelo esinjengendudumo, kodwa ngovavanyo olulula kodwa olunzulu lokholo. Isizwe sasimi kwindawo enqamlezileyo, sifuna ulwalathiso lukaThixo lobunkokeli. Okwavelayo yayiluvavanyo olukrelekrele kangangokuba lwaluza kutyhila amakholwa okwenene phakathi kwabo. Ngaba ungayityhila le mfihlakalo kwiindlela ezishiyekileyo?
clues: Ndivela kwisizukulwana abantu ababesihlonipha, kwaye uAllah wandikhethela injongo engcwele ababengenakuyiqonda.
Umzimba wam wawunophawu lokwahluka olwalungekho kwabanye, nto leyo eyandenza ndahluka phakathi kwabantu bam.
Xa umlambo wavakaliswa njengovavanyo, uninzi lwajika lwabuyela umva—kodwa mna ndaqhubeka phambili, ndiqhutywa lukholo olungagungqiyo kwisithembiso sika-Allah.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndingaze ndisele emanzini angavumelekanga, kodwa ithontsi elinye laphuma emilebeni yam—isono esasihlala sihlupha intliziyo yam.
U-Allah wandimisela ukuba ndidibane nomalusi oselula owayeza kuba yintsomi ngokubulala utshaba olunamandla ngenye imini.
Xa imikhosi yayilwa, andizange ndiwe sisandla sotshaba, kodwa ndawa ngumyalelo kaThixo njengesohlwayo sokungathobeli kwam emlanjeni.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukwala ukusela kuMlambo iNayile ngexesha le-Eksodus
Ukuvavanya umkhosi ngokubayalela ukuba bangaseli emlanjeni ongcwele
Ukwakhiwa kweTempile yaseYerusalem kwiminyaka engamashumi amane
trial.answer: Ukuvavanya umkhosi ngokubayalela ukuba bangaseli emlanjeni ongcwele

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Ndaba ngukumkani omkhulu ndaza ndakha itempile yaseYerusalem
Ndawa edabini njengesohlwayo sesenzo sam esinye sokungathobeli
Ndasindiswa lukholo lwam ndaza ndaba ngumprofeti
Umkhosi wam woyise lonke ihlabathi elaziwayo
Ndaphila ndaza ndabona unyana wam uSolomon ezuza ubukumkani bam njengelifa
outcome.answer: Ndawa edabini njengesohlwayo sesenzo sam esinye sokungathobeli

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
